advanced.title: Fizzlayer server
advanced.description: Use {base_url}, or the URL of a self-hosted Fizzlayer. A pairing code is created while you are signed in on the Fizzlayer Sensors page and typed into this Home Assistant. A code from a message is not yours.

link.title: Your code is {code}
link.description: Type {code} on the Fizzlayer Allow page, then choose Allow. This screen waits until you do. [Open the Allow page]({url}). Integration version {version}. Server: {base_url}.

data_description.code: Type this code on the Allow page. Leave it as shown here.

reauth_confirm.title: Fizzlayer connection expired
reauth_confirm.description: The connection was revoked. Link it again to keep sending readings.

entities.title: Choose sensors
entities.description: Home Assistant will push these to Fizzlayer. Temperature, humidity, power, door, and leak sensors start selected. Your plan has {remaining} device slots left (each entity uses one).

error.invalid_url: Enter an https URL, or http://localhost for a server on this machine.
error.invalid_code: That pairing code is not valid or has expired. Create a new one on the Fizzlayer Sensors page.
error.device_limit: Your Fizzlayer plan's device limit is reached. Remove a device or upgrade, then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Fizzlayer could not be reached. Check the URL and try again.

abort.timeout: Linking timed out. Start again from the Fizzlayer Sensors page.
abort.expired: This link expired. Start again from the Fizzlayer Sensors page.
abort.already_linked: This link was already used. Start again if you still need to connect.
abort.rate_limited: Too many link attempts. Wait a little and try again.
abort.invalid_auth: Fizzlayer rejected the connection. Remove it and link again.
abort.no_entities: No sensor or binary sensor entities were found.
abort.already_configured: This Fizzlayer connection is already set up.

init.title: Home Assistant sensors
init.description: Entities you clear are removed from Fizzlayer. Adding one uses a device slot on your plan.

error.device_limit: Your Fizzlayer plan's device limit is reached.

abort.invalid_auth: Fizzlayer rejected the connection. Link it again.
abort.no_entities: No sensor or binary sensor entities were found.
